decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Details of the kerb line alteration of the egress onto the A4 shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the approved works shall then be carried out before 1 December 2008 or the occupation of Building B (the hotel) as that building was approved under planning permission reference 00505/P/P59 dated 8 December 2006, whichever is the earlier.
description: Following planning permission (00505/P/P59) on 8 December 2006, on the same day the associated Section 106 deed was completed, for:Retention and alteration (including limited, selective demolition) of Wallis House in association with the re-instatement of employment use (B1), the creation of a gallery (D1), the provision of a health club (D2) and the introduction of residential use (C3) of the building.  The retention, alteration and extension of International House and its use as a restaurant (A3) and incubator business units (B1).  The demolition of all other buildings on the site and redevelopment for mixed employment (A1, A2, A3, A4, B1 and C1), community (D1 and D2) and private and affordable residential (C3) use, together with associated public and private open spaces, access roads, service areas, 1,045 car parking and landscaping.  The proposed buildings range from 4- to 10-storeys in height and a 25-storey tower.details submitted pursuant to: condition 33 (sightlines)
